messages:
Taylor: hi everyone, taylor here on my first week. my Buildkite pipeline fails when attempting to push the docker image to GHCR with a 403. unsure which token to use or whether org app is required. any quick pointers?

InfraBot: Buildkite: step `publish-image` failed (exit 1)
```
> Pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/taylor-sandbox:pr-5
> denied: requested access to the resource is denied
> failed to push some refs to 'ghcr.io/redwood-inference/taylor-sandbox'
```

Taylor: pipeline env has GHCR_PAT set from the token i created during onboarding. i selected `repo` and `workflow` scopes.

Nora: welcome! :wave: GHCR pushes require `packages: write` (and read) — `repo`/`workflow` alone isn't enough. preferred flow is org GitHub App with packages permission, but a PAT with `write:packages` will also work.

Ken: small checklist: 1) confirm the PAT has `write:packages`; 2) confirm the token is actually pasted into Buildkite project secrets and referenced correctly (env var name matches); 3) if using GH Actions sidecar or `GITHUB_TOKEN`, note that auto GITHUB_TOKEN often lacks package write by default.

Taylor: is there a quick local test for token scope?

Nora: yes run:
```
echo "$TEST_PAT" | docker login ghcr.io -u <your-username> --password-stdin
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/taylor-sandbox:canary
```
if that returns `denied` the PAT is missing packages. also `gh auth status` can help.

Taylor: ran docker login locally and got `denied`. regen'd token with `write:packages` + `read:packages` and updated Buildkite secret. requeued the build.

InfraBot: Buildkite: build #307 started - step `publish-image`

InfraBot: Buildkite: build #307 succeeded  - image pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/taylor-sandbox:pr-5

Taylor: nice! build passed. leaving a note in my onboarding doc about PAT scopes and preferring org app. thanks y'all :smile:
